name: models3d_remesh
description: Retopologize (default) or simplify a 3D model with Tripo (default) or Meshy. Quads require a quad-capable export such as FBX.

creationIdentifier.description: A 3D model creation: from `models3d_generate`, `creations_search`, or an uploaded GLB.

faceLimit.description: Tripo only. Retopology: up to 20000 (quads 10000), omit for adaptive. Simplify: up to 2000000 (quads 150000), default 30000.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

targetFormats.description: Meshy only. Default [glb]; fbx or obj keep quads. The first is the result `url`, the rest `creations_get` `otherFormats`.
